raw.query: WITH attn AS (SELECT source_path, n_images, ms, ms / n_images::double precision AS ms_per_image, total_kernel_ms FROM provenance.collector_kernel_ledger WHERE entry_kind = 'category' AND entry_name = 'attention'), flags AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name = 'is_current') AS has_is_current, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name = 'is_superseded') AS has_is_superseded, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name LIKE '%effective%') AS has_effective FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'provenance' AND table_name = 'collector_kernel_ledger'), ledger AS (SELECT supersedes FROM provenance.ledger_entry WHERE name = 'Kernel ledgers N=1/N=64  (2026-07-08)') SELECT COUNT(*) AS denominator_rows, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('n_images', n_images, 'attention_ms', ms, 'attention_ms_per_image', ms_per_image, 'total_kernel_ms', total_kernel_ms) ORDER BY n_images) AS per_batch_breakdown, MAX(ms_per_image) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 1) AS n1_ms_per_image, MAX(ms_per_image) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 64) AS n64_ms_per_image, ABS(MAX(ms_per_image) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 64) - MAX(ms_per_image) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 1)) / MAX(ms_per_image) FILTER (WHERE n_images = 1) * 100.0 AS absolute_difference_pct, (SELECT has_is_current FROM flags) AS has_is_current, (SELECT has_is_superseded FROM flags) AS has_is_superseded, (SELECT has_effective FROM flags) AS has_effective, (SELECT supersedes FROM ledger) AS ledger_supersedes FROM attn
